# Gemini and Antigravity CLI Skills

> **Superseded.** The legacy Node-based Gemini CLI is obsolete; the Antigravity CLI
> (`agy`) replaces it — see `third-party/antigravity-cli/skills` for the current contract.
> This document is retained as a migration reference for the legacy layout only; do not
> treat its paths or flags as current.

## Overview

The CLIs support Agent Skills defined by `SKILL.md` files.

## Locations

| Scope               | Gemini CLI Location | Antigravity CLI Location (`agy`)    |
| :------------------ | :------------------ | :---------------------------------- |
| **User Global**     | `~/.gemini/skills/` | `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills/` |
| **Workspace Local** | `.gemini/skills/`   | `.agents/skills/`                   |

## Sources

- https://geminicli.com/docs/cli/skills/
- https://antigravity.google/docs/gcli-migration
